quotes.text: Many K-pop fans of all the groups involved, known as "multis," gave everyone their two cents on the matter.
quotes.reference: 2021 August 25, Vibha Hegde, “BTS, Blackpink, and Stray Kids asked to disband by disgruntled fans”, in SKPop:

quotes.text: Our Mesozoic antecedents are typified by small size; even the largest of the multis are not larger than a groundhog.
quotes.reference: 1996, Michael Novacek, Dinosaurs of the Flaming Cliffs, page 316:

senses.definition: (informal) Neolamprologus multifasciatus (small shell-dwelling cichlid endemic to Lake Tanganyika, popular as aquarium fish)
(bridge) A contract bridge convention whereby the opening bid of 2♦ shows several possible types of hands.
